user_story: As a user, I want the system to reject a new password shorter than 8 characters during reset so that security standards are maintained.

positive.title: Password reset with 8 or more characters
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Input a new password with 8 or more characters.
positive.expected_result: The password is accepted, and the user is informed that their password has been successfully reset.

negative.title: Attempt password reset with fewer than 8 characters
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Input a new password with fewer than 8 characters.
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the new password and displays a message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.

edge.title: Password reset with exactly 8 characters
steps: Navigate to the password reset page.
Input a new password with exactly 8 characters.
edge.expected_result: The password is accepted, and the user is informed that their password has been successfully reset.
